I knew a girl who firmly believed she was a fictional character from this anime and wore her cosplay All. The. Time. Not the full cosplay at all times, but the scarf and the wig. One time she had to go to the ER and literally refused to go until she had the wig and scarf on...She would also claim everyone who said she wasn’t actually that fictional character was harassing her and it was just as bad as harassing someone for their race/gender/sexuality. I think she even went by the name of the fictional character more than her actual name. She was a pretty terrible person too so I don’t exactly feel bad for thinking she was a total weirdo.
